pitch2.headline: AI literacy is the new hiring filter
pitch2.body:
66% of leaders say they won't hire candidates who can't demonstrate AI proficiency. DataCamp 2025.

**The filter isn't about coding.** It's about whether you can work alongside AI tools fluently — in writing, research, analysis, and communication.

Your existing domain expertise is genuinely valuable. Training adds the layer that makes it legible to modern employers.

pitch.headline: How AITutoro trains career changers differently
pitch.body:
Generic AI courses teach tools in isolation. AITutoro starts with your existing background and builds the specific fluency that hiring managers test for.

**The five-hour threshold is the target.** AITutoro structures training so you cross it with skills you can demonstrate — not just checkbox completions.

Adaptive assessment means no time wasted on material your career experience already covers.
